description: For a helper session that is not in the call: sets its own status board on the call page, shown as 'Helper <label>: <helper_name>' below the main agent; the main agent's board stays as it is. Same limits as status (doing max 400 chars, open / done max 10 items). Empty doing, open and done removes the helper's board. Returns ok.

credential.description: Helper credential `token` from helper_credential or POST /api/helper/credential.
credential.title: Credential

helper_name.description: Name of this helper session, 1-40 chars (shown on the call page as `from`).
helper_name.title: Helper Name

name: helper_status
title: Helper: set own status board
